llm.evidence: 5 µl of each sample were analyzed by an Orbitrap Q-Exactive plus (Thermo Scientific) mass spectrometer
analyzed by label-free, quantitative liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS).
Sequencing grade trypsin (Worthington, Lakewood, NJ, USA) was added in a ratio of at least 2 µg per mm3 tissue.
The MS was operated in data dependent mode and each MS scan was followed by a maximum of ten MS/MS scans.
1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) (AppliChem, Darmstadt, Germany) were added to each reaction tube
followed by 30 mM iodacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, USA) for 15 min at 37 °C
